edition_angle: Epigenetic and Multi-Omic Interplay in Phytochemical Neuroprotection

assignments.angle: How targeted phytochemicals like berberine and resveratrol modulate multi-omic networks, mitochondrial quality control, and epigenetic mechanisms to counter neurodegenerative stress.
assignments.reason: Provides a detailed biophysical and cellular mechanism spanning multi-omics, Nrf2/NF-kB signalling, and epigenetic regulation (DNA methylation/histone modifications) in neuroprotection, fitting the criteria for primary mechanistic research.
